title: Changing a line to another inactive part is refused
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create an active part, part A, for this test, and add it to the approved line, line 1, of an open work order, work order 1, made for this test.
  • Create two more parts for this test: part B, set inactive, and part C, left active.
  • Set part A inactive after it is on line 1.
  • Start on work order 1, on its Lines tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click the part A row on line 1.
  2. Replace the part number with part B's part number.
  3. Click Save.
  4. Click the part A row on line 1.
  5. Replace the part number with part C's part number.
  6. Click Save.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The part A row on line 1 of work order 1 opens for editing.

Step 2:

  • The field holds part B's number.

Step 3:

  • The change is refused with part B's part number followed by "is inactive. Activate it from the Inactive tab to use it.", and the row still holds part A.

Step 4:

  • The part A row opens for editing.

Step 5:

  • The field holds part C's number.

Step 6:

  • The change saves and the row now holds part C.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work)

  • S9-E2a: “Changing that line to a different part, or typing a different number on it, is new work and follows S9-R17.”
  • S9-R17: “The system refuses an inactive part on new work however it arrives: adding a part to a work order or estimate line, raising a part request or special order, adding a part sale line, and adding a purchase order line or changing its part or number. The refusal reads "{part number} is inactive. Activate it from the Inactive tab to use it."”
  • S9-E2: “The user can still change the quantity, price and notes on that line, and save it again with the same part or number.”
